statuses.full: the rule, what happens otherwise, and worked examples
statuses.rule: the rule and what happens otherwise, no examples
statuses.partial: the rule named or described loosely, without its edge cases

R1.title: MAJOR.MINOR[.PATCH][:tag]; missing patch is 0; strict grammar

R2.title: numeric cores; untagged above tagged; tags run by run, digits below letters

R4.title: ~V: at least V, same major and minor

R5.title: ^V: at least V, same major; same minor too when major is 0

R6.title: *, M.x, M.N.x; nothing else is a wildcard

R7.title: , is AND, | is OR; spaces only around separators

R8.title: a tagged version needs a tagged comparator with the same major.minor

R9.title: errors name version or range; the version is checked first

note: The skeleton, the same at every level, says it throws an Error on invalid input, so R9 is partial at L3 and L4.
